name: suggestions-cards
note: Issue #205 (#513): each card is one Narrator list item named by its title, which is a Level 2 heading (H/Shift+H stop), in page order after Filter; every row is one 40+ epx focusable Button named with its song, artist, year and reason.
after_ready: assertread:name=Track 44, Artist E · 2012, last played season 8|Track 44, Artist E · 2012, last played season 8, button
assertstate:name=Track 44, Artist E · 2012, last played season 8|type=button
assertstate:name=Track 44, Artist E · 2012, last played season 8|focusable=true
assertsize:name=Track 44, Artist E · 2012, last played season 8|40x40
assertsize:name=Track 32, Artist M · 2023, last played season 1|40x40
assertapart:name=Track 44, Artist E · 2012, last played season 8|name=Track 32, Artist M · 2023, last played season 1
assertorder:name=Pro Lead Untouched for 2 Seasons|name=New on Tap Vocals

name: suggestions-keyboard
note: Issue #205 (#513): a card's rows are one Tab stop; Down/Up move row by row inside a card and across card boundaries (they used to scroll the list); Tab/Shift+Tab move between cards and back to Filter; Enter opens the filter on Instruments and Esc returns focus to Filter.

name: suggestions-filter
note: Issue #205 (#513): the filter's Instruments and General Expanders are named (they had no UIA name: Axe NameNotNull) with their description as help text and their expanded state; heading -> Instruments -> General -> Instrument-Specific -> instrument picker -> Reset order; Enter expands and the next Tab lands on the first named instrument switch (no silent stop on the switch list), Space toggles it; 40 epx headers and Reset; Axe-scanned open.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.suggestions.filter.instruments|Instruments, button, collapsed, Choose which instruments appear in your suggestions.
assertread:id=fst.suggestions.filter.general|General, button, collapsed, Toggle broad suggestion types on or off.
assertread:id=fst.suggestions.filter.instruments|Instruments, button, expanded, Choose which instruments appear in your suggestions.
assertread:id=fst.suggestions.filter.general|General, button, expanded, Toggle broad suggestion types on or off.

name: suggestions-syncing
note: Issue #205 (#513): while the player's scores sync (HTTP 202) the state's title "Syncing Scores" is a Level 2 heading carrying fst.suggestions.syncing (a StackPanel has no UIA peer), read after its named ring and before its explanation.
after_ready: assertorder:id=fst.suggestions.filter-button|name=Busy Syncing scores|id=fst.suggestions.syncing|name=This player's scores are still being prepared. Suggestions will appear once they're ready.

name: suggestions-no-results
note: Issue #205 (#513, #377): with every suggestion type switched off the empty state's "No Suggestions" title is a Level 2 heading carrying fst.suggestions.no-results, read after Filter ("Filters applied") with its message, and offers no second Reset; Esc from the filter returned focus to Filter.

name: suggestions-rival-pill-contrast
note: Issue #205 (#513): a mixed-rival row's rival name pill keeps its brand fill by default and switches to the neutral contrast role (ButtonFace fill, ButtonText outline) when a contrast theme turns on while the page is open, and back when it turns off. Probes sit left of the pill's label (fst.suggestions.row.<song>.<instrument>.rival): 5 epx in is the fill, 9 epx in the 2 epx outline.
after_ready: assertread:name=Track 34, Artist O · 1999, Lead, rival Rival B4, behind by 2 ranks|Track 34, Artist O · 1999, Lead, rival Rival B4, behind by 2 ranks, button

name: suggestions-named-rival
note: Issue #656 (Suggestions R1): a card that names one rival lists only that rival. In seed 1 the first remix's "Gain Stars & Beat Rival B3" (Level 2 heading, one Narrator list item after Filter) holds rows that are each a 40+ epx Button whose name ends with that rival ("5 ranks behind Rival B3"), and the rows draw no rival name pill because the title already names the rival (suggestions_journey.py rival-rows checks the pill and every named card it loads).
ready: waitfor:name=Track 31, Artist L · 2019, Bass, 5 ranks behind Rival B3@10
after_ready: assertread:name=Track 31, Artist L · 2019, Bass, 5 ranks behind Rival B3|Track 31, Artist L · 2019, Bass, 5 ranks behind Rival B3, button
assertread:name=Track 23, Artist D, Pro Lead, 12 ranks behind Rival B3|Track 23, Artist D, Pro Lead, 12 ranks behind Rival B3, button
assertsize:name=Track 31, Artist L · 2019, Bass, 5 ranks behind Rival B3|40x40

name: suggestions-load-more
note: Issue #260 (#521): the cards Suggestions loads as the list nears its end (a batch of six after the first ten) fade in on arrival with motion on and appear in place under Reduce Motion or with Animation effects off; either way they arrive whole for Narrator: each new card is a list item named by its Level 2 title heading, read after the last card of the first batch, and its rows are 40+ epx Buttons named with song, artist, year and reason.

assertstate:name=Track 19, X · 2004, Lead, 60 ranks ahead of Rival A2|focusable=true

assertstate:name=Protect Your Lead vs Rival B2&class=TextBlock|heading=2
assertorder:name=New on Pro Lead|name=Protect Your Lead vs Rival B2

name: suggestions-load-more-keyboard
note: Issue #260 (#521): the keyboard crosses from the first batch of cards into the ones loaded after it, with motion on or off: Down from the last row of card 10 lands on the first row of card 11 and Up returns; Tab walks one stop per card through the loaded batch into the next one it loads, and Shift+Tab walks back.
